title.zh: Republicans Post Final CLARITY Act Text With Trump-Backed Ethics Terms a Day Before Cloture Vote
title.en: Republicans Post Final CLARITY Act Text With Trump-Backed Ethics Terms a Day Before Cloture Vote

current_state.zh: Republicans released the final CLARITY Act text, revising ethics terms by removing the January 20, 2029 sunset, reversing the July bar on state attorney general enforcement, and raising civil penalties to 20% of the take or $500,000, whichever is greater, ahead of a Senate cloture vote.
current_state.en: Republicans released the final CLARITY Act text, revising ethics terms by removing the January 20, 2029 sunset, reversing the July bar on state attorney general enforcement, and raising civil penalties to 20% of the take or $500,000, whichever is greater, ahead of a Senate cloture vote.
